🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel.

Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire.

Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu.

L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit.

Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. Les principales étapes du stage seront les suivantes :

·        Étude bibliographique : synthèse des connaissances sur les liants magnésiens, leurs mécanismes d'hydratation et leurs applications potentielles.

·        Caractérisation des matières premières : étude de la composition chimique et minéralogique, de la distribution granulométrique (PSD) et de la réactivité des matières premières sélectionnées.

·        Formulation et préparation des liants : élaboration de pâtes de ciment de type MgO-SiO2 en utilisant différentes sources de magnésium et différents paramètres de préparation.

·        Caractérisation des matériaux : analyse des pâtes hydratées par diffraction des rayons X (DRX), analyse thermogravimétrique (ATG), microscopie électronique à balayage couplée à la spectroscopie à dispersion d'énergie (MEB/EDS), mesure de la porosité accessible à l'eau et essais mécaniques.

Analyse des résultats : comparaison des différentes formulations afin d'identifier les principaux paramètres influençant leur microstructure et leurs propriétés mécaniques.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs, spécialisé(e) en génie civil, science des matériaux ou domaine connexe.

jobs.title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
jobs.description:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI)

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

  • Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama

  • Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):

Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning

Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :

L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.

Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.

Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.

Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.

Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.

Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?

Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage

L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

  • Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

  • Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact).

Profil recherché

  • Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ;

  • Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API)

  • et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ;

  • Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier.

Références

Huguet M, Pehlivan C, Ballereau F, Dodane-Loyenet A, Fontanili F, Garaix T, Yordanov Y, Augusto V, Tazarourte K, Redjaline A. Indoor positioning systems provide insight into emergency department systems enabling proposal of designs to improve workflow. Commun Med (Lond). 2025 Mar 11;5(1):72.

Ayed SB, Layeb SB, Huguet M, Fontanili F, Samama N. Developing a Mobile Application and Dashboard for Proactive Management of Patient No- Shows via Geolocation and Dynamic Scheduling. In: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Healthcare Systems (ICAHS). IEEE; 2025 Dec. p. 1-5.

Trabelsi M, et al. TRACE4PM: Trace Related Analysis and Clustering for Process Modeling of Users Interactions in IS. In: RCIS 2025. Springer; 2025.

Rebmann A, et al. Evaluating the Ability of LLMs to Solve Semantics-Aware PM Tasks. In: ICPM 2024. IEEE; 2024.

Kourani H, Berti A, Schuster D, van der Aalst WMP. Process Modeling with Large Language Models. In: BPMDS/EMMSAD@CAiSE 2024. 2024. p. 229- 244.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production.   • Define how the team judges feasibility, including real-world limits beyond data sheets, edge cases and clear no-go criteria

  • Develop our requirement workshop format and handover standards further

  • Track which use cases keep coming up and which we win or lose, and feed these insights into focus areas and the product roadmap

  • Pitch to strategic customers, give talks at trade fairs and events, and decide with Marketing and Product what we demo and why

  • Stay the technical lead for your own Account Executives and share their quota

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Extensive experience in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including time at a senior level

  • Experience working against a quota and winning complex deals

  • A track record as the person colleagues turn to when a feasibility question gets hard

  • The ability to recognize patterns across projects and turn them into rules, templates and tools that others use

  • Experience leading through expertise, with the trust of engineers and sales leaders in your technical judgement

  • The confidence to make a go/no-go call and stand behind it, even when a deal is on the line

  • Strong presence on stage and in the boardroom, from trade fair talks to pitches to strategic customers

  • Fluent German (C1+) and fluent English (C1+), and willingness to travel, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Experience building sales or partner enablement programs is a plus

  • A background at a robot manufacturer or system integrator is a plus

How you'll make an impact

  • You drive important, ambiguous initiatives to outcomes and define standards and approaches your peers adopt.

  • You translate strategy into execution with significant latitude and design improvements aligned with business goals.

  • You are a recognized subject matter expert at RobCo and set the technical or functional standards in your area.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

jobs.description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

    • We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round.

    • The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. We're an AI Health Tech company in the UK and Europe, leading from the front in the AI Diagnostics space.

Our AI Platform, DERM, is the UK’s and Europe’s first autonomous Class III AI as a medical device, certified to the same safety standard as a pacemaker. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
  • Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
  • Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
  • Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
  • (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
  • Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
  • Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

  • Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
  • Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
  • Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
  • Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
  • Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices. 

NYC Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 USD

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 20 employees a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🔋Recharge Period: end-of-year company-wide time off to rest and reset

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆(Netherlands only) Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

  • 🚲 (Ireland only) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit

  • 🔌 (UK only) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Test Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company.

We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites.

About this role:
As a Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us!
  • Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry!
  • Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant!
    • Key responsibilities include:
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links.
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns.
    • Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone.
    • Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms.
    • Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests.
    • Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration.
      • Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally.

Must Haves:
  • 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP).
  • Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools.
  • Experience containerizing applications with Docker.
  • Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines.

Nice to Haves:

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Manager
jobs.description:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. 

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen.
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.



ÜBER DEINEN JOB

  • Zusammen mit unserem CEO übernimmst du Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Geschäftsentwicklung bei freiheit.com 
  • Dafür hast du immer ein klares Ziel im Blick: Den Erfolg Deiner Kunden.

    • Client Success

Deine Verantwortung ist es, diese zu beseitigen und damit sicherzustellen, dass das Engineering Team effektiv und effizient arbeiten kann und unsere “Optimal Work Environment” sichergestellt ist.

  • Du bist im Herzen Unternehmer und hast ein ausgeprägtes “Customer-First Mindset” und ein erstklassiges Gespür im Umgang mit Kunden. 
  • Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrung bei der kommerziellen Planung und Auslieferung von komplexen large-scale Software-Projekten.
  • Du bist begeistert von Technologie und erstklassigem Software Engineering. 
  • Du arbeitest sehr präzise und bist sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen. 
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 
  • Du fühlst Dich wohl im Umgang mit Engineers & Non-Engineers, bist offen und ehrlich und arbeitest gern im Team.

jobs.title: (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)
jobs.description:
Shape the future of bioanalysis for innovative medicines

 

Celerion is one of the world's leading bioanalytical contract research organizations and has been supporting pharmaceutical and biotech drug development programs around the world for more than 40 years.

To strengthen our bioanalytical laboratory in the Ligand Binding Service Team in Fehraltorf / Zurich, we are looking for a

                                    (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator (100%)*

 

In this role, you will take scientific and operational ownership of regulated bioanalytical studies and method validations. You will serve as the primary client contact, lead study execution from planning through reporting, and play a key role in delivering high-quality data to support drug development programs worldwide.

 

* This is a dual-level posting. The hiring team will determine the final level and title of the role based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required for the level offered.

Main responsibilities

Study Leadership & Scientific Oversight

  • Lead and oversee GLP/GxP-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.
  • Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.
  • Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.
  • Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

Client Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.
  • Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.
  • Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.
  • Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.

Additional Responsibilities for Senior-Level Candidates

  • Lead complex or strategic client programs.
  • Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for ligand-binding and cell-based assay technologies.
  • Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.

Our requirements

  • BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field
  • At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position
  • Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell-based), preferably in an industry setting
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail
  • Excellent computer and time management skills
  • Highly self-motivated, reliable, and flexible, with a commitment to providing excellent service to clients.
  • Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
  • Excellent English (written and spoken), good German skills are advantageous
  • Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role is required for the senior position
  • Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients is advantageous

 

Your chance

We provide an opportunity to assume work independently, secure long-term employment, and enjoy a competitive salary.

Your workplace will be located within our state-of-the-art equipped automated facilities in cantone Zurich as part of an international organization. 

Additionally, you will experience the advantages of flexible working hours and experience the benefits of a medium-sized company with flat organizational structure within a dynamic and international team.

Our benefits: extra holidays, company-paid sickness and accident insurance, commuting allowance and access to Reka-Checks.

jobs.description:
Wenn Maschinen gewartet, repariert oder wieder einsatzbereit gemacht werden müssen, sollte auch das SAP-System wissen, was zu tun ist. Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel! Für unseren Kunden suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP Senior Consultant mit Schwerpunkt Customer Service (CS), der Service- und Reparaturprozesse nicht nur versteht, sondern auch im SAP-System effizient abbildet und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Aufgabenbereich
In dieser vielseitigen Funktion übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Konzeption, Implementierung und Betreuung von SAP Customer Service (CS). Sie analysieren die Anforderungen der Fachbereiche, entwickeln passende Lösungen und setzen diese technisch um. Dabei konfigurieren und optimieren Sie die relevanten SAP-Funktionalitäten und begleiten Projekte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg, von der Anforderungsaufnahme über das Testing bis zur Einführung und Schulung der Anwender. Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Ihrer Tätigkeit ist zudem die Integration von SAP CS in angrenzende Module wie SD, MM, PP und FI/CO. Sie analysieren Fehler, finden nachhaltige Lösungen und sorgen dafür, dass die Service- und Reparaturprozesse auch systemseitig rund laufen. Technische Dokumentationen, funktionale Spezifikationen und Testkonzepte gehören ebenfalls zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich.

Ihre Sozialkompetenz
Sie überzeugen durch eine analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und verlieren auch bei komplexeren Anforderungen nicht den Überblick. Der Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen bereitet Ihnen Freude, und Sie verstehen es, zwischen technischen Möglichkeiten und betrieblichen Bedürfnissen zu vermitteln. Sie arbeiten gerne eigenständig, schätzen aber ebenso die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Kommunikationsstärke, eine ausgeprägte Lösungsorientierung und die Bereitschaft, sich in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln, runden Ihr Profil ab.

Know-how
Sie verfügen über mindestens vier bis fünf Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Implementierung und Betreuung von SAP Customer Service (CS). Die Konfiguration der relevanten Funktionalitäten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Pricing, Billing, Shipping und Customer Service, beherrschen Sie ebenso wie die Integration in andere SAP-Module. Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA und Fiori setzen wir voraus. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich, wobei Sie insbesondere in Englisch auch schriftlich und mündlich sicher kommunizieren.

Unser Kunde
Unser Kunde ist ein international führendes Industrieunternehmen mit einer eindrücklichen Firmengeschichte. Mit innovativen Technologien und einem umfassenden Produktportfolio ist das Unternehmen weltweit tätig und zählt zu den bedeutenden Anbietern seiner Branche. Sie erwartet ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld, eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung sowie ein motiviertes Team, das Wert auf gegenseitigen Respekt und eine gute Zusammenarbeit legt. Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und interessante Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten runden das Angebot ab.

Interesse?

Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About the Role

This is a full-time internship of at least 6 months at our Berlin HQ, and it is not a regular internship application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built.

If you build with AI because you can’t stop, with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or anything else, show us. If your project convinces us, we shape the internship around you and your strengths.

 

What We Want to See

Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention:

  • Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet.

  • A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think.

What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too.

 

What Your Loom Should Cover

  • The problem: what you solved and why it matters.

  • The demo: show it working live, not on slides.

  • How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it.

  • What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that.

  • What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own a real project. Ideally it’s the one you showed us. You take it from prototype to something our team or customers actually use.

  • Work directly with the team. You work alongside Product, Engineering, or GTM, depending on where your project lives.

  • Ship, measure, iterate. You present your progress regularly and decide based on real feedback.

 

How to Apply

Paste your Loom URL into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough.

  • You think in impact, not just in technology.

  • You show high agency. You don’t wait for tasks; you find them.

  • You experiment constantly with new models and tools.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

 

What We Need

  • Availability for a full-time internship of at least 6 months, 100% on-site in Berlin.

  • A work permit for Germany.

 

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us.

jobs.title: Compliance Director
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

jobs.title: Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) - Agentur für Handelsmarketing
jobs.description:
TEAMWFP ist eine Agentur für kreatives VkF-Marketing in Mönchengladbach. Seit 45 Jahren betreut die Agentur Unternehmen aus Handel und Finanzen in der Verkaufs- und Markenkommunikation: Prospekte, Mailings, Instore Design, Verpackungen und Kampagnen, für Kunden wie PENNY, Kaufland oder die Sparkassen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Beraterin oder ein erfahrener Berater als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde, mit eigenen Kunden und einem Beraterteam von fünf bis sechs Leuten.

Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du berätst viele Kunden aus Handel und Finanzen, ohne mehrere Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen und ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde und koordinierst jedes Projekt vom Briefing bis zur Produktionsreife.
  • Du vertrittst die Agentur in Abstimmungen beim Kunden und arbeitest dich inhaltlich in alle Projekte ein.
  • Du bereitest Briefings verständlich für dein Team auf und erarbeitest kommunikative Lösungen, allein oder mit der Kreation.
  • Du prüfst alle Werbemittel formal und inhaltlich, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und kalkulierst und überwachst die Kosten selbst.
  • Du übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben der Geschäftsführung und steuerst das Beraterteam mit.

Was du mitbringst

  • Eine Ausbildung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Marketingkommunikation oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing. Erfahrung zählt mehr als der Abschluss.
  • Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld oder in einer Marketingabteilung auf Kundenseite, Handelsmarketing ist ein Plus.
  • Fundiertes Marketingwissen, mit dem du Kunden strategisch berätst und Leistungen verkaufst.
  • Du greifst gern zum Hörer, behältst in vollen Phasen die Ruhe und bist sicher in Excel, Word und PowerPoint. Sehr gutes Deutsch ist Voraussetzung.

Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet

  • Ein Gehalt ab 4.000 € im Monat, je nach Erfahrung nach oben offen.
  • Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: In Beratung und Kreation sitzen erfahrene Leute am Tisch, Entscheidungen fallen schnell und direkt.
  • Viele Kunden und nie dasselbe: Vom Handel bis zur Bank übernimmt die Agentur fast jede Aufgabe, die ein Kunde stellt, und arbeitet bei den meisten Kunden nicht in festen Teams.
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht.
  • Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing.
  • Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar.

Ehrlich gesagt: Als Schnittstelle hängst du an vielen Leuten. Vom Kunden brauchst du Infos, von Konzept und Gestaltung pünktliche Ergebnisse, und phasenweise wird es stressig. Der Tipp aus dem Team: von Anfang an die eigenen Grenzen setzen.

Diese Stelle wird über JobMatches vorgestellt. Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) bei TEAMWFP in Mönchengladbach. Nach einem kurzen Telefonat lernst du Kim Finocchiaro und die Geschäftsführung persönlich kennen.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

jobs.title: Product Development Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About TACTILIA:

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Product Development Lead at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.

You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.

What you will do:

  • Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

  • Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

  • Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

  • Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

  • Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

  • Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

  • Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

  • Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

What you bring:

  • A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience developing mechatronic or hardware products, including experience in product development or technical project/program management.

  • A proven track record taking products from requirements through development to production readiness.

  • Strong requirements management and a solid understanding of systems engineering.

  • Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary teams without direct line authority.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and time-to-market.

  • A hands-on, structured approach and the ability to move between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus.

Bonus

  • Experience in robotics, drive technology, gripping technology, or other highly integrated mechatronic systems.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or a corporate spin-off.

  • Familiarity with relevant robotics, machinery or functional safety standards.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Amazon Specialist / Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind

Als innovatives und wachsendes Unternehmen erfinden wir uns täglich neu. Auf der Suche nach neuen Produkten, um unser Portfolio zu erweitern und das stetige Wachstum aufrechtzuerhalten, werden die Prozesse durch unser dynamisches Team immer wieder auf die Probe gestellt und optimiert. In agilen Strukturen kreieren wir neue Marken und etablieren diese mit ihren Produkten seit über 10 Jahren bestmöglich im Markt. Amazon ist dabei unser wichtigster Vertriebskanal, daneben spielen Marktplätze wie eBay und Kaufland eine große Rolle.

Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf Zukunftstechnologien: In unserem Lager übernimmt Robotik die Kommissionierung, und künstliche Intelligenz unterstützt uns in immer mehr Bereichen, von der Datenanalyse über Produkttexte bis zur Automatisierung unserer Abläufe. Zu unseren großen Stärken gehören schnellste Versandzeiten und unschlagbare Preise durch schlanke Prozesse, die einer ständigen Verbesserung unterliegen.

Deine Aufgaben, Dein neuer Job

Du kennst dich bestens mit Amazon aus und betreust bei uns alle Amazon-Themen. Mit deinem Fachwissen, deinem analytischen Blick und deinem Gespür für Zahlen sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Marken auf Amazon wachsen, profitabel bleiben und sicher aufgestellt sind:

  • Überwache laufend die Performance unserer Produkte (Umsatz, Sessions, Conversion, Buy-Box-Anteil, Rankings) und leite bei Abweichungen schnell die richtigen Maßnahmen ab

  • Plane, steuere und optimiere Werbekampagnen (Sponsored Products, Brands und Display) im Sinne eines datengetriebenen Performance Marketings mit Blick auf ACoS, TACoS und Profitabilität

  • Entwickle Preis- und Deal-Strategien und setze Coupons, Deals, Prime Day und Black Friday gezielt ein

  • Optimiere bestehende Listings dort, wo die Daten Potenzial zeigen, und stimme neue Listings und A+ Content mit unserem Content-Team ab

  • Baue Bewertungen über Vine und Bewertungsanfragen auf und leite aus Kundenfeedback Verbesserungen für unsere Produkte ab

Du hältst unseren Account gesund und unsere Marken sicher:

  • Behalte die Account Health im Blick, löse Richtlinienverstöße und gesperrte Listings und setze Fälle beim Seller Support durch

  • Schreibe Einsprüche und Maßnahmenpläne, wenn es darauf ankommt

  • Schütze unsere Marken über die Brand Registry und gehe gegen Hijacker und unerwünschte Inhaltsänderungen vor

  • Stelle sicher, dass Pflichtangaben und Compliance-Anforderungen (z. B. GPSR, EPR, Gefahrgut) in den Listings erfüllt sind

Du steuerst mit Zahlen und behältst den Markt im Blick:

  • Stimme Bestände und Nachschub mit Einkauf und Lager ab, damit unsere Bestseller nie ausverkauft sind

  • Werte Business Reports, Brand Analytics und Search Query Performance aus und behalte den Deckungsbeitrag je Artikel im Blick

  • Analysiere Wettbewerber, Rankings und Markttrends und gib Impulse für neue Produkte

Neben Amazon betreust du auch unsere weiteren Marktplätze:

  • Verwalte unsere Angebote auf eBay, Kaufland und weiteren Marktplätzen und übertrage bewährte Strategien von Amazon

  • Pflege Produktdaten in unserer Warenwirtschaft (JTL-Wawi)

  • Wenn du möchtest, bringst du unsere Marken auf weitere europäische Amazon-Marktplätze

Dein Profil, Du…

  • hast mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Amazon Seller Central, von Listings über Werbung bis Account Health

  • hast bereits erfolgreich Amazon-Werbekampagnen verantwortet und kennst die wichtigen Kennzahlen

  • weißt, wie man mit dem Seller Support umgeht, und bleibst auch bei kniffligen Fällen dran

  • kennst die aktuellen Anforderungen an Produktsicherheit und Compliance auf Amazon

  • denkst analytisch, liebst Zahlen und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten

  • behältst auch dann einen kühlen Kopf, wenn der Marktplatz mal wieder seine eigenen Regeln schreibt

  • arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein

  • bist kommunikativ und arbeitest gerne im Team

  • hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit eBay, Kaufland oder anderen Marktplätzen

  • kennst idealerweise Tools wie Helium 10, Jungle Scout oder Sellerboard

  • hast idealerweise schon mit JTL-Wawi gearbeitet

  • sprichst gutes Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

Unternehmenskultur und Benefits

  • Wir streben eine langjährige Zusammenarbeit an und bieten Raum für persönliche Weiterentwicklung, Förderung und Umorientierung

Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business.

This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users.

Your Mission

  • Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production.
  • Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters.
  • Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow.
  • Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day.
  • Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues.
  • Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why.
  • Raise the bar: Share knowledge,

Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end.
  • Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.
  • You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management.
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems.
  • Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma.
  • Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase.
  • Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship.
  • High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English required; German is a plus.
  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Vector search (pgvector or similar).
  • Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.
  • Observability and product analytics tools (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, PostHog).
  • Python for data tooling.
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale or B2B environments.

Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes: Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities: Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.

  • Company pension program (bAV): Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution, investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership: Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
